title: Time Jump: 16:20 — Device Network Isolation Confirmed

fields.narration: Facilitator to all: It is now 16:20 on Thursday, March 12, 2026. The Incident Commander has authorized the isolation of the device network (10.40.x.x). The firewall rule has been applied by the ISO. The central telemetry system on ORRMC-MON01 is now disconnected from all devices on 10.40.x.x. All imaging modalities, lab analyzers, and bedside monitoring systems on the device network are offline. The pump server ORRMC-PUMP01 remains accessible only to internal network management. The 22 highest-risk pumps have been swapped. Nineteen pumps on library 4.2.2 remain in use, but only for low-risk infusions. The sample from the six high-alert infusions has been sent to the lab via runner.
worldState: The device network (10.40.x.x) is now isolated from the rest of the hospital network.
ORRMC-MON01 no longer receives data from any device on 10.40.x.x.
All imaging, lab, and monitoring devices on 10.40.x.x are offline.
The pump server ORRMC-PUMP01 is accessible only internally.
The 22 highest-risk pumps have been swapped to 4.2.1.
19 pumps on 4.2.2 remain in use for low-risk fluids only.
The lab has received the six high-alert infusion samples via runner.
fields.facilitatorNote: This inject confirms the isolation decision and activates the clinical impact. Watch for the CNO to request manual monitoring for ICU 3 North and 3 South, and for the PIO to begin drafting family communications. The lab result will be in the next inject.
